question.text: Returns of Fund A over 5 years: 12.5%, 11.25%, 13.65%, 17.3%, 14.65%. The mean is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Mean = (12.5+11.25+13.65+17.3+14.65)/5 = 69.35/5 = 13.87%. The Trap: Other options are incorrect arithmetic. Cross-Exam Context: Matches Example 9 in the workbook. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Recompute independently before referencing — small errors compound.
